conditional_field.meaning: Append one of two values to each original row using a caller-chosen text or signed integer comparison. Each branch chooses field:N or text:literal. Preserve encounter order, fields and positions.

field_text_length.meaning: Append the number of Unicode code points in a selected UTF-8 field to the complete original row. Include combining code points and preserve original positions.

graph_witnesses.meaning: Follow directed edges for an exact positive length or any positive length (closure). Emit distinct source, first hop, destination and direct-edge flag rows in lexical tuple order, including nonempty cycles. Output positions are one-based result ranks.
